$description: Cloud Del Norte community brand — night-sky desert palette. Navy #00002a, Elevation #0a0a2e, Violet #9060f0, Deep Purple #5a1f8a, Award Orange #ff9900, Desert Gold #c9a23f. No white ink anywhere.

navy.$description: Night Sky — primary ground. Deep navy field for skies and dark grounds.

desertGold.$description: Desert Gold — lizard team. Warm gold for the horned lizard ball carrier.

elevation.$description: Elevation — raised plots. Lighter navy for ridges, halls, turf bands.

awardOrange.$description: Award Orange — the ball. High-signal orange reserved for the football.

violet.$description: Violet — edge light. Bright violet for outlines, sparkles, visiting team.
